episode_summary: In this episode, Sam Burke shares how he built a successful real estate business at a young age by maintaining high standards and leveraging digital strategies like YouTube for lead generation. He discusses the importance of relationship building, personalized outreach, and having a clear investment strategy. Sam's insights provide valuable lessons for both new and aspiring top-producing agents.
